What we do

Engineering Governance

We handle the complexity of global sourcing, vetting, and delivery management. Gun.io provides the governance layer your team needs to transform engineering effort into impact.

Eliminate the Resume Lottery

Stop bad applications. We produce a high-precision shortlist of developers who aren't just "available," but are sought after, vetted, and matched to your stack and delivery goals.

Deploy Talent, Not Paperwork

Our platform handles the negotiations, contracts, and onboarding infrastructure. No complexity, no administrative debt—just engineering capacity, unlocked.

Managed Outcomes

Top 1% talent" is a liability if it only results in expensive meetings. We not only work with elite talent, we ensure that the work gets done.

Payroll

Multi-currency payroll and tax compliance executed across 100+ countries, ensuring your global engineering spend is operationally sound and fully compliant.

Performance

Continuous milestone tracking and performance auditing to ensure technical output keeps pace.

Reporting

Detailed billing, work results, and ongoing support from Gun.io.

Compliance

We handle compliance—from contract execution to local IP and labor law adherence—mitigating your risk of global scaling.

Billing

We align expense with output, and provide an audible trail of every dollar spent towards engineering.

Technical Review Protocol

Building teams is risky. Each engagement begins with a structured assessment: technology review, constraint mapping, and delivery risk identification—before we even talk about people. We only move forward once we’ve mapped out exactly how the work gets done.

Team & Architecture Assessment

We only deploy engineers evaluated against our standard with a verified history of delivery within our ecosystem. Every professional is selected for their ability to maintain our standard under complex, real-world constraints.

Global Operations

Payroll, compliance, and contracts handled across 100+ countries. Cross-border complexity is managed as a baseline function.

Delivery Oversight

We don't just hand off a team and walk away. We stay in the project, tracking code quality and architectural drift against the original vision. If your roadmap shifts, we adjust the mix of skills on the fly to maintain velocity. If the delivery doesn't hit the standard, we take responsibility for fixing it—even if that means redeploying the team.

Verified Delivery History

We only deploy engineers evaluated against our standard with a verified history of delivery within our ecosystem. Every professional is selected for their ability to maintain our standard under complex, real-world constraints.
